task.title: Notarize macOS desktop builds
task.description:
Desktop builds ship ad-hoc signed and unnotarized, so Gatekeeper needs right-click Open on first launch, and the app's update check on macOS has to download the DMG and open Finder because Squirrel.Mac refuses to install over a bundle it cannot verify.

Needs an Apple Developer account and a Developer ID certificate plus notarization credentials in repository secrets. With them: sign with the identity in `desktop/scripts/after-pack.js` (or electron-builder's own signing), notarize in the publish workflow, and let the Mac path of the update check use Squirrel.Mac like Windows does. Degrade to ad-hoc when the secrets are absent, the way Windows signing already degrades.

Depends on the publish task.
